_about: OSM name sweep of the spine-UNMATCHED link pins, 2026-09-23 (Photon, OSM data). CONFIRM = an OSM feature of a POI type with a matching name within 60 m of our pin. REVIEW = a same-name feature further away that was NOT acted on (chain branch, loose name, place member, or over 1 km). Coordinates are what the pin held when checked; a moved pin invalidates its row. Not read by any check; a record so the sweep is not redone blind.
